tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kha'u sman chabs kyi gzhi bdag spyi la spring yig bzhugs so// shrī sa skya pa 'jigs bral dpal ldan chos skyong gi ring lugs 'dzin par skyes shing des sku gsung thugs kyi brtul zhugs bzung ba ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po lhag bsam can gyi yi ge kha'u'i ri lung sogs la gnas pa'i lha klu btsan bdud rgyal po ma mo the'u rang sa bdag gnyan mthu bo che sogs mdor na 'das pa'i lha sangs rgyas byang sems mkhas grub du ma'i zhal mjal zhing / de dag gi bka' dang dam tshig la gnas nas gdul bya'i snod bcud tshul bzhin skyong ba rnams dang 'jig rten rang rgyud pa phan gnod nges par byed nus pa mtha' dag la springs pa/ spyir sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyi gsung las bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ 'gro na ma chags/ 'dug na ma dgo 'gro ba la bshol 'debs ma byed/ 'dug pa la bskul ma ma byed/ gnas mgron gyi dam tshig srung / 'gro 'dug bya ba spyod lam ci byed kyang rung nga dang phrag dog ma byed par chos mthun gyi don yid bzhin sgrub dgos lan cig min par rgyun du bstsal zhing / mchod sbyin byed par dmigs pa yod med thams cad kyi rgyun 'don yin pa bzhin/ gnas mgron dam tshig bsrung rgyu der gnas bdag rnams kyi'ang / gnas der legs nyes btang 'dzin tshul bzhin byed cing / mgron gzhis sdod mi rnams kyi'ang gtor ma sogs mchod sbyin rgya che chung ci nus kyi sgo nas/ phan tshun grogs su 'gro ba zhig dgos rgyu yin 'dug pas na/ khyad par da lam gyi gnas skabs 'di la der yod lha 'dre tshang mar zer rgyur/ lung pa 'di'i mi phyugs ri dwags bya nya sogs srog chags rigs kyi nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung zhing / mthun rkyen tshe ring nad med rigs brgyud/ sa ma 'brog gi longs spyod 'bri g.yag ra lug sogs dud 'gro rigs bcas/

mdor na bcud kyi phywa g.yang dar zhing rgyas pa dang / ri klung gi rtsa chu sa rdo sogs snod kyi yon tan thams cad dpal dang gzi brjid nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyis shig yang sgos dam pa rnams kyi thugs rje dang skye 'gro'i bsod nams las bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi sogs nad do cog zhi bar byed pa'i chu tshan khag mang 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong byed mchis pa skyes chen rnams kyi sku'i 'phrod bzhes la/ 'jug pas mchod yon zhabs bsil sogs mchod rdzas kyi gras su 'gro bas byin rlabs can gyi khrus rdzing yin 'dug cing / 'gro rnams bde bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi sman gyi rdzing bu yin 'dug pas na 'das pa'i lha rnams chu tshan 'di rnams nam yang nyams pa med par byin gyis rlobs la srung skyob tshul bzhin mdzod cig 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams rang nyid dga' min gyi chu tshan la tsha grang he log gis/ gzhan la gnod pa bskyal na rnam smin rang thog tu yong bas bag yod par byos la dro 'jam snyoms shing chu rgyun bzang la gcong can gang gi'ang ma phan pa rnams/ 'di nas gcong zhi mu zi ldong ros sogs kyi rgyu las byung ba'i chu rnams rang rang nad gzhir phan pa sman pas bsgo ba bzhin 'dug pas nad med lang tsho bde ba de 'phral du 'byung ba'i phrin las gyis shig bye brag 'dod rgyal gyis sgra las/ dga' bo chu tshan du grags pa 'dir kho bos bdag rkyen byas pa yin pa rba log 'jigs rung sogs/ sems can la gnod pa mtha' dag ma gtong bar chu tshan lus la 'phrod pa cis kyang 'byung ba'i 'phrin las gyis shig de ltar byed dgos pa'i rngan par gzhi bdag drag zhan tshang mar ji srid 'khor ba'i bar du longs spyod rung bar sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dkar dmar skyur sogs bza' bca' ldag myangs btung bar dmigs pa snod dang bcas pa dang / rin chen 'bru gos dar sogs mkho dgu'i yo byad 'di rnams bsrings yod pas des tshim zhing mnyes par gyis la kho bos ji ltar bsgo ba'i/

'phrin las lo zla zhag 'gyangs med par gyis la dar rgyas yun du brtan pa'i 'phrin las gyis shig/ //ces go bar bya ba'i yi ge dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog pho brang gi yang steng gzim chung 'dzam gling phun tshogs dpal 'bar zhes sku gsung thugs rten du ma bzhugs pa'i sku drung nas bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ kha'u sman chab kyi gzhi bdag spyi la springs yig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
